name: China

seo.title: China Travel Guide: Beijing, Xi’an, Shanghai & More
seo.description: Plan China travel with guides to Beijing, Xi’an, Shanghai, Guilin-Yangshuo and Chengdu: history, landscapes, food, UNESCO sites and itineraries.
seo.h1: China Travel Guide: Five Essential Destinations

heading: China Travel Guide: Five Essential Destinations
description: China offers imperial palaces, ancient archaeology, global cities, karst landscapes and regional food. This content set features Beijing, Xi’an, Shanghai, Guilin/Yangshuo and Chengdu.
Beijing and Xi’an are the strongest historic pages, Shanghai represents modern China, Guilin represents landscape tourism and Chengdu represents food and wildlife.
The five destinations are connected by flights and an extensive high-speed rail network.

quickFacts.Entry: Visa and visa-free rules depend on nationality and change; check official Chinese government sources

citiesSection.heading: Top Cities in China
citiesSection.body: Choose a city to see its main places to visit.

cities.name: Beijing
cities.intro: Beijing has been China’s imperial and political centre for much of the last millennium.
cities.knownFor: Forbidden City, Great Wall, Temple of Heaven, imperial gardens

cities.name: Xi’an
cities.intro: Xi’an was the capital of several Chinese dynasties and the eastern starting point of the Silk Road.
cities.knownFor: Terracotta Army, city wall, Silk Road heritage, Muslim Quarter

cities.name: Shanghai
cities.intro: Shanghai grew from a river and coastal trading settlement into an international port and one of Asia’s leading financial cities.
cities.knownFor: The Bund, skyline, Yu Garden, Art Deco, shopping

cities.name: Guilin and Yangshuo
cities.intro: Guilin and Yangshuo are famous for karst mountains, rivers, caves, rural landscapes and Chinese landscape painting traditions.
cities.knownFor: Li River, karst peaks, rice terraces, cycling

cities.name: Chengdu
cities.intro: Chengdu is the capital of Sichuan and a major centre of food, tea culture, technology and panda conservation.
cities.knownFor: Giant pandas, Sichuan food, teahouses, Three Kingdoms history
